plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog p. 200 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA in English requires 19 major units (ENGL 1B, ENGL 5, plus four courses from the approved literature/creative-writing list). The sequence selects ENGL 30A, ENGL 10A, ENGL 30B, ENGL 10B, and ENGL 31. REQUIREMENT 'Major Elective' mapped to major. All ENGL courses above ENGL 1A list 'ENGL 001A or ENGL 001AS' as prerequisite (ENGL 1B lists ENGL 1A); coded as ENGL 1A because the validator only matches top-level course codes and ENGL 1AS appears solely inside the Fall Y1 ENGL choice's options — the in-plan Fall Y1 ENGL 1A/1AS choice satisfies the prerequisite. Catalog quirk: Fall Y2 prints 'AFRAM 32 African-American History: 1945 to Present' (in other sequences AFRAM 31 carries the '1945 to Present' title) — kept verbatim. Unit ranges use the lower bound; Fall Y1 prints '15-19'. Computed total 61 (sequence sums above the 60-unit degree minimum). Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
